title: Integrated Care Solutions | HatchWorks AI
description: Integrated Care Solutions (ICS) provides patient-centered clinical solutions, innovative IT applications, data analytics, and customized advisory services to those responsible for the quality and cost of care including hospital systems, physician groups and organizations utilizing bundled payments, ACOs or other value-based payment models. ICS partnered with HatchWorks to build Care+ a highly functional, automated, integrated, and customized tool assists ICS in providing population health patient care management and transition management, while also supporting programs such as Medicare BPCI Advanced.
